source_caption:
From the wild nightlife of New York City to an unexpected journey into fatherhood, A24’s 𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐁 𝐊𝐈𝐃 is already making waves! 🔥⁣
⁣
Written, directed by, and starring Jordan Firstman in his feature directorial debut, CLUB KID follows a hard-partying New York City club promoter whose chaotic lifestyle is turned upside down when the 10-year-old son he never knew existed suddenly enters his life.⁣
⁣
Blending the underground world of New York nightlife with an unconventional story about family, identity, and responsibility, CLUB KID also features Cara Delevingne and Colleen Camp. CLUB KID hits Belgian theaters on November 11 and Dutch theaters on November 12, brought to you by A24 and 18K Film.⁣
⁣
One of the most talked-about directorial debuts at Cannes ever, could this be A24’s hit? 🎬

source_details.title: Club Kid
source_details.synopsis: Club Kid is a 2026 American comedy-drama film written, directed, and starring Jordan Firstman, in his feature directorial debut. It also stars Cara Delevingne, Kirby Howell-Baptiste, Colleen Camp, Vicki Pepperdine, Nigil Whyte, Eldar Isgandarov, Saturn Risin9, Miss Benny, Alaska Riley, Diego Calva, and Reggie Absolom. The film premiered in the Un Certain Regard section of the 2026 Cannes Film Festival on May 15, where it was nominated for the Caméra d'Or and the Queer Palm. It received a limited theatrical release in the United States by A24 on November 6, 2026 and received widespread praise from critics.
